name: Ulhas

source.name: Sahyadri hills, near Rajmachi/Khandala, Sahyadri Range

did_you_know: Near Thane the Ulhas splits into two tidal distributaries, Vasai Creek and Thane Creek, which separate Salsette Island (housing much of Mumbai) from the mainland.
Its estuary hosted the historic ports of Kalyan and Shurparaka, trading centres since antiquity, long before Mumbai's rise.

The river and its Bhatsa and Barvi tributary dams are a key source of drinking water for the densely populated Mumbai Metropolitan Region, even as urban pollution has become a major stress on its lower course.
